name: Aktivhotel Crystal
beschreibung: Aktivhotel Crystal is situated in St. Johann in Tirol, within the district of Kitzbühel. The property is located close to the town center and the mountain cable car. Guests can unwind in a wellness area featuring a sauna and steam bath. The hotel organizes guided hikes and ski lessons. Half board is included with the stay. The hotel is ideal for active vacationers looking to explore the picturesque Kitzbühel Alps.
